title: Group Product Manager — AI Legal Intelligence (Hybrid/Remote)
jd_excerpt:
Relativity is seeking a Group Product Manager to lead claiR, Relativity's conversational AI experience for lawyers, end to end. You will own the product vision, guide the PM team, and stay hands-on as claiR moves toward general availability.

You will bring proven success launching an AI/LLM-powered product, manage enterprise customer relationships, and align cross‑functional teams across product, design, engineering, and go‑to‑market efforts, with regular travel to customer sites.
